public_rationale: This is a rhetorical description of how the speaker was treated. 'Practically an entire field' tried to 'shout me down' has no threshold or observable measure. Whether this happened 'long before the data were in' depends on a contested judgment about when scaling evidence arrived. Records could show that some researchers and executives criticized him. They could not show what share of a field tried to silence him, so the claim cannot be fairly scored true or false.
limitations: Individual critical responses to Marcus exist but were not compiled, since no count would settle 'practically an entire field'.
